title: Independent source observations in the original CAD frame

nativeGeometryAssumptions.description: At most one of each closed user-approved declaration: rod-head functional mapping pending CAD match, and only the exact two lower-rocker side-face features permitted absent and uncertified. Neither establishes whole-part correspondence, a measured/topology fidelity pass or source availability, nor exempts the native census, pose, camera, motion, other features, 38.4-source-pixel or 0.5-second requirements. Original hole contours remain source diagnostics; no native holes, textures or source pixels may be fabricated.

authority.const: the one plate-like head vs u crosspiece is a discrepancy but both serve the same purpose; the 3d model will be fixed later to match device; animate assuming they will match later

interpretation.const: Functional linkage mapping for animation only; not a current geometric-fidelity pass.

sourceCounterpart.const: Two small rimmed/recessed lower-rocker side-face features either side of the fulcrum

interpretation.const: Only the two declared side-face features may remain absent from the native rockers and uncertified; animation-only exception, not whole-part correspondence or a measured/topology fidelity pass.

sourceNonIdentifiableFixedPart.description: An explicitly approved, rendered native structural fixed part whose actual source region is not identifiable, not excluded or geometric-fidelity passed. Runtime qualification must reject mechanism-driven, deforming and source-overridden parts and cover the actual native ID pixels with this source region.

interpretation.const: Rendered source-non-identifiable fixed part; not geometric-fidelity passed.

sourceNonIdentifiableFixedParts.description: Explicitly empty when none. Exact record duplicates are rejected here; duplicate native paths, overlapping census classifications, source-region bounds, fixed-motion eligibility and binding equality are runtime-verified against the full native inventory.

pixelFormat.description: Full-range 8-bit gray from original limited-range 8-bit yuv420p luma: clip(floor((Y-16)*255/219+0.5),0,255). Hash raster bytes only, without an image header.

principalPointViewportPixels.description: Fixed independently evidenced principal point, viewport-local and unmirrored; may lie outside the viewport.

warpMeasurementEvidence.description: Exact independently decoded original target and reference exposures plus the actual measurement recipe. Projected/inverse-warped native points are not source observations.

cornersSourcePixels.description: Measured image boundaries in reference TL,TR,BR,BL identity order; sole H authority, all four are fitting constraints.

correspondences.description: At least two disjoint genuinely measured interior image-feature checks spread across reference content; corners and fit rows do not count.

resolvedImagePlaneWarp.description: Derived row-major native-unmirrored-viewport to original source-global pixel H. Independently recomputed from four measured corners; never an authored second authority.

sourceLayout.description: Complete ordered simultaneous view support. Later views in one image mask earlier supported pixels; distinct fading images contribute their common image weight once.

partLocalLineMetres.description: Finite independently qualified native geometry segment; never reconstructed from the camera being checked.

sourceLinePixels.description: Actually measured source-global segment, not named 3D endpoints at invented image rows.

uncertaintyPx.description: Independent conservative Euclidean final source-global localization/raster-quantization bound, matching landmark uncertaintyPx. It excludes native raster, geometry/perspective and raster-fit error. H never transforms this already-source-global term; warped observations require a bounded supported localization footprint.

axisPerspectiveBiasBoundPx.description: Unchanged authored axis bound in the declared coordinate space, not necessarily final-source pixels. Native viewport bounds may exceed 38.4; acceptance compares the propagated geometry plus independent source/native/residual/fit terms in final source-global pixels.

axisPerspectiveBiasComponents.description: Independently evidenced additive decomposition in axisPerspectiveBiasSpace (ordinary default source-global). Components must sum to the unchanged authored axis bound. Inclusive certificates are source-global only and sourceLocalizationBoundPx must equal the check's unchanged uncertaintyPx; only the geometry component is added alongside that localization term. No subtraction inferred from magnitude or prose.

axisPerspectiveBiasSpace.description: Mandatory for homography views; unwarped geometry bounds are propagated by an independently recomputed H Jacobian over a region containing the entire inverse source-localization footprint plus native geometry radius. The already-source-global uncertaintyPx is never H-scaled.

axisPerspectiveBiasRegionViewportPixels.description: Finite [x,y,width,height] within the unwarped viewport. For every endpoint and every paired-edge midpoint, inverse-map its supported source-global uncertaintyPx square on the positive projective branch, then expand the whole inverse footprint by geometryBoundPx; this entire expansion must lie in the region. Runtime/static/GPU validators enforce the cross-field containment before using the region's Jacobian bound.

axisPerspectiveEvidence.description: Physical justification and independent bound for silhouette midpoint versus projected cylinder-axis perspective asymmetry; source-image edge pairs remain the observations.

role.description: Declared original source use. CHECK is not a claim of newly independent camera or mechanism holdout; inherited objective ancestry remains required.

sourceContourPixels.description: Independently measured source-global contour samples, bound to the actual decoded exposure; never native projections used as source observations.

uncertaintyPx.description: Independent conservative Euclidean final source-global localization/raster-quantization bound, matching landmarks and native line checks. Added exactly once to nearest captured boundary distance and native raster uncertainty; unknown/null fails closed. H does not transform an already-source-global bound; warped localization footprints must remain bounded and supported.

sourceToViewportPixels.description: Row-major [s,0,tx,0,s,ty], s>0, from reference source-global pixels to unmirrored viewport-local pixels; no shear or rotation.

uncertaintyPx.description: Qualified conservative Euclidean source-pixel measurement bound including source localization/raster quantization. Native GPU raster uncertainty is independently propagated and added once; unknown/null source uncertainty cannot become zero.

mechanismInput.description: Arrays are physical GLB station/instance order: harmonic 20 down to 1, not ascending harmonic order.

driveCrankOffsetTurns.description: Measured crank-to-bank offset: engaged drive uses crankTurns minus this. Never defaulted for source footage.

sourceConstraint.description: Closed independently source-measured constraints. Ordered interval bounds, feasible native solutions, unique constraint identities and complete measured-versus-unobserved accounting are also enforced by runtime verification.

oneOf.description: Independently measured pen-travel interval evaluated against the actual solved magnifier.penTravelM output; does not directly observe its unknown input operands.

witnessBinding.description: Runtime verification requires exact equality with the enclosing source/model/frame/view identity, complete witness input, camera, ROI, presentation, composite, overrides, constraints, continuity, declared geometry assumptions and the proof's exact source-non-identifiable fixed-part records including their literal authority; this record is not an independent or status-only assertion.

sourceOcclusion.description: An independently measured opaque human-hand interior in this exact original decoded image, not a darkness heuristic, native-derived mask or general object waiver. Runtime/static checks require a convex nondegenerate non-self-intersecting in-image polygon, exact proof image equality and a point certificate [decodedTimeSeconds, decodedTimeSeconds] at that exact time. Native qualification additionally requires fresh depth GPU readback, independently supplied exact current source image/time/view/camera/layout binding and the whole positive native ID-cell extent strictly inside with source-mask plus actual-native uncertainty margin. A single exposure cannot certify other images or interpolated/held times.

visibilityProof.description: Every native inventory path must appear exactly once as independently source-corresponded, evidentially excluded or explicitly user-approved source-non-identifiable structural fixed. A measured per-original-exposure opaque human-hand source-occluded exclusion remains SOURCE-OCCLUDED, not source-corresponded or geometry-passed; all legacy exclusions require zero actual native IDs. Approved fixed parts remain rendered and are not measured/geometric-fidelity passed; moving, deforming or source-overridden parts cannot use that bucket. No unresolved part or native geometry assumption establishes coverage. Full inventory membership, cross-bucket uniqueness, fixed-motion qualification, actual source-region/native ID pixels, references and exact binding records are runtime-verified without relaxing pixel or timing limits.

runtimeWitness.description: A chosen feasible source-compatible reconstruction, not recovered hidden history. Runtime accounting requires every one of the 51 scalar coordinates to be directly measured or explicitly unobserved; relation-constrained operands remain individually unobserved.

sourceMachineRequirement.description: Optional monotonic strict-required declaration for this exact decoded source frame. Overrides a broader shot exemption without splitting or weakening its census; never exempts a frame, qualifies a camera/input/alpha/H, or promotes a source pose.
